_doc: The frames shared ACROSS films, from HANDOFF §7. The treatments encode reuse inside a film - reuse_of and crop_of - but eight shots are marked source=reuse with no source named at all, because the frame they reuse lives in a different film and a treatment only knows its own shots. Without this the assembler falls back to a shot's own id, finds no render, and lays down a placeholder card: the still sage, the most reused plate in the arc, would have been a placeholder in M3, M4 and M5.
_rule: This resolves WHICH FRAME a reuse shows. It never makes a new frame, never changes a claim, and never opens a gate. A plate is generated once, in the film HANDOFF names, and every later film shows that same file - which is the point: a shifted fold in the sage's cloth across four films breaks the stillness that is the performance.
_note: HANDOFF §7 also lists M6/05 under the spent king. It needs no entry here: M6/06-05 names reuse_of=06-01, and 06-01 is listed above, so the chain resolves through it to M5/05-16. Only the eight shots that name no source at all are listed.
